messages:
amanda_cs: FYI intake from Borealis — they have a reproducible issue where a regen after an embed call resets sequence numbers to 0, losing session continuity. Pasting customer repro and logs below. INC-4201 created.

inc-bot: Created INC-4201 — priority P2. https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/INC-4201

borealis-cs: (customer paste) Steps to reproduce:
1) POST /embeddings with session_id=abc123 -> returns embeddings and token offsets
2) Later, POST /chat/regen with session_id=abc123 and same conversation_id
Observed behavior: regen response JSON shows first token with "seq": 0 and subsequent tokens not aligned with prior conversation. Context appears truncated.
Attached log excerpt:
```
[2026-02-18T14:02:11Z] session=abc123 model=gptx-2.4-q4 embed_call OK
[2026-02-18T14:02:18Z] session=abc123 regen_call start
[2026-02-18T14:02:18Z] regen_out token=0 seq=0 text="Hello"
[2026-02-18T14:02:18Z] regen_out token=1 seq=45 text="there"
```

sanjay_support: Quick clarifying q: is this on Dedicated or Hosted? Which region? Also model and quantization level?

amanda_cs: It's Dedicated in us-west-2. Model: gptx-2.4-q4. Customer says issue started after last week's model software update. They reported demo failures for search regen flows.

teri_engineer: @amanda_cs can you paste the minimal curl the customer used? want to try repro locally on staging. Also do we have a sanitized session dump? :eyes:

borealis-cs: Minimal curl they gave:
```bash
curl -X POST https://dedicated.us-west-2.redwood.example/v1/regen \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"session_id":"abc123","conversation_id":"conv-77","prompt":"continue","last_token_index":58}'
```
Response snippet:
```json
{"id":"r1","tokens":[{"seq":0,"text":"Hello"},{"seq":45,"text":"there"}],"status":"ok"}
```

teri_engineer: I can reproduce on our dedicated staging with same model/quant. Looks like KV cache mapping is being rebuilt between the embed and regen paths when session state contains a conversation_id but no explicit kv snapshot. Suspect regression in session mapping layer from last deploy. Will open ENG ticket and attempt patch.

leo_prod: Thanks for the heads-up. Customer impact: they run ~2k qps bursts on that flow and it's breaking demos — treat as P2 for Dedicated. If fix is <=3 dev-days, target next sprint; if it's invasive to runtime we should consider a hotfix. Tagging as customer-impact and will reserve a hotfix slot if engineering needs it.

amanda_cs: Customer is blocked for an upcoming demo on Friday — they prefer a hotfix. I'll escalate with the AE and ask for a waiver for accelerated deployment. :fingers_crossed:

teri_engineer: Created ENG-7892 with repro, logs, and initial diagnosis. Will try a small change to preserve KV mapping path and run the regression test suite. ETA for a hotfix attempt: EOD tomorrow.

amanda_cs: Great — I'll update the customer and mark INC-4201 as 'awaiting fix'. Adding a follow-up item to product backlog for automated integration test to catch embed->regen session continuity. :thumbsup:
